cohort: 176 newborns admitted to the Department of Neonatology, Division of Pediatrics, University Medical Centre, Ljubljana, because of neonatal seizures
finding: Gestational age at birth modifies the association between duration of seizures and the risk of developing epilepsy later in childhood.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was found to be an independent predictor of epilepsy after neonatal seizures.
gest_age: Mean gestational age not mentioned (70.5% term, 29.5% preterm)
